name: Clicky Mouse Prototype
author: nyx318
description:
This is my submission for Prototype 5 as part of the Junior Programmer Pathway. I tried my best to design all the bonus features (lives UI, music volume slider, pause screen, click & swipe) myself, but I had to consult the solutions a bit for the expert challenge.

This is a fruit ninja type game where your reflexes will be put to the test. You can choose between 3 difficulty levels. Hold down LMB to keep popping all the balls, but be careful of the bombs – bursting one will result in your score dropping and on hard difficulty, it will reduce your lives too.
